items.source: In SearchOperations, and so in ElasticsearchOperations as well, the suggest methods taking a org.elasticsearch.search.suggest.SuggestBuilder as argument and returning a org.elasticsearch.action.search.SearchResponse have been deprecated. Use SearchHits<T> search(Query query, Class<T> clazz) instead, passing in a NativeSearchQuery which can contain a SuggestBuilder and read the suggest results from the returned SearchHit<T>.
items.translation: 在SearchOperations中，同样也在ElasticsearchOperations中，接受org.elasticsearch.search.suggest.SuggestBuilder作为参数并返回org.elasticsearch.action.search.SearchResponse的suggest方法已被弃用。 请使用SearchHits<T> search(Query query, Class<T> clazz)替代，传入一个包含SuggestBuilder的NativeSearchQuery，并从返回的SearchHit<T>中读取建议结果。

items.source: Elasticsearch is working on a new Client that will replace the RestHighLevelClient because the RestHighLevelClient uses code from Elasticsearch core libraries which are not Apache 2 licensed anymore. Spring Data Elasticsearch is preparing for this change as well. This means that internally the implementations for the *Operations interfaces need to change - which should be no problem if users program against the interfaces like ElasticsearchOperations or ReactiveElasticsearchOperations. If you are using the implementation classes like ElasticsearchRestTemplate directly, you will need to adapt to these changes.
items.translation: Elasticsearch 正在开发一个新的客户端以取代 `RestHighLevelClient`}，因为该客户端使用了 Elasticsearch 核心库中的代码，而这些代码不再采用 Apache 2 许可证。Spring Data Elasticsearch 也在为此变化做准备。这意味着内部针对 `*Operations` 接口的实现需要发生变更——如果用户像往常一样基于 `ElasticsearchOperations` 或 `ReactiveElasticsearchOperations` 等接口进行编程，则不会受到影响。如果您直接使用实现类（如 `ElasticsearchRestTemplate`），则需要对这些变更进行调整。

items.source: The SearchHits<T>`class does not contain the `org.elasticsearch.search.aggregations.Aggregations anymore. Instead it now contains an instance of the org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.AggregationsContainer<T> class where T is the concrete aggregations type from the underlying client that is used. Currently this will be a org .springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.clients.elasticsearch7.ElasticsearchAggregations object; later different implementations will be available. The same change has been done to the ReactiveSearchOperations.aggregate() functions, the now return a Flux<AggregationContainer<?>>. Programs using the aggregations need to be changed to cast the returned value to the appropriate class to further proces it.
items.translation: `SearchHits<T>` 类不再包含 `org.elasticsearch.search.aggregations.Aggregations`。取而代之的是，它现在包含一个 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.AggregationsContainer<T>` 类的实例，其中 `<T>` 是底层客户端所使用的具体聚合类型。目前，这将是一个 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.clients.elasticsearch7.ElasticsearchAggregations` 对象；将来将提供不同的实现。对 `ReactiveSearchOperations.aggregate()` 函数也进行了相同的更改，它们现在返回一个 `Flux<AggregationContainer<?>>`。使用聚合的程序需要修改以将返回值强制转换为适当的类，以便进一步处理。

items.source: Up to version 4.2 the fields property of a Query was interpreted and added to the include list of the sourceFilter. This was not correct, as these are different things for Elasticsearch. This has been corrected. As a consequence code might not work anymore that relies on using fields to specify which fields should be returned from the document’s _source' and should be changed to use the `sourceFilter.
items.translation: 在 4.2 版本之前，Query 的 fields 属性会被解析并添加到 sourceFilter 的包含列表中。这是不正确的，因为在 Elasticsearch 中这两者是不同的概念。此问题现已修复。因此，依赖使用 fields 来指定应从文档的 _source 返回哪些字段的代码可能不再有效，应改为使用 sourceFilter。

items.source: In the org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.annotations.CompletionContext annotation the property type() has changed from org.elasticsearch.search.suggest.completion.context.ContextMapping.Type to org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.annotations.CompletionContext.ContextMappingType, the available enum values are the same.
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.annotations.CompletionContext` 注解中，`type()` 属性的类型已从 `org.elasticsearch.search.suggest.completion.context.ContextMapping.Type` 更改为 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.annotations.CompletionContext.ContextMappingType`，可用的枚举值保持不变。

items.source: The default value for the search_type in Elasticsearch is query_then_fetch. This now is also set as default value in the Query implementations, it was previously set to dfs_query_then_fetch.
items.translation: Elasticsearch 中 `search_type` 的默认值为 `query_then_fetch`。 现在，`Query` 实现中的默认值也设置为 `query_then_fetch`，而之前则默认为 `dfs_query_then_fetch`。

items.source: The org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.mapping.ElasticsearchPersistentPropertyConverter interface has been renamed to org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.mapping.PropertyValueConverter. Likewise the implementations classes named XXPersistentPropertyConverter have been renamed to XXPropertyValueConverter.
items.translation: org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.mapping.ElasticsearchPersistentPropertyConverter 接口已重命名为 org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.mapping.PropertyValueConverter。 同样地，名为 XXPersistentPropertyConverter 的实现类也已重命名为 XXPropertyValueConverter。

items.source: In ReactiveSearchOperations the new suggest methods return a Mono<org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.suggest.response.Suggest> now. Here as well the old methods are deprecated.
items.translation: 在ReactiveSearchOperations中，新的suggest方法现在返回Mono<org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.suggest.response.Suggest>。同样地，旧的方法已被弃用。

items.source: In the org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.annotations.Document annotation the versionType() property has changed to org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.annotations.Document.VersionType, the available enum values are the same.
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.annotations.Document` 注解中，`versionType()` 属性已更改为 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.annotations.Document.VersionType`，其可用的枚举值保持不变。

items.source: In the org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.Query interface the searchType() property has changed to org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.Query.SearchType, the available enum values are the same.
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.Query` 接口中，`searchType()` 属性已更改为 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.Query.SearchType`，可用的枚举值保持不变。

items.source: In the org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.Query interface the return value of timeout() was changed to java.time.Duration.
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.Query` 接口中，`timeout()` 方法的返回值已更改为 `java.time.Duration`。

items.source: Spring Data Elasticsearch also removes or replaces the use of classes from the org.elasticsearch packages in it’s API classes and methods, only using them in the implementation where the access to Elasticsearch is implemented. For the user that means, that some enum classes that were used are replaced by enums that live in org.springframework.data.elasticsearch with the same values, these are internally mapped onto the Elasticsearch ones.
items.translation: Spring Data Elasticsearch 还会在其 API 类和方法中移除或替换来自 `org.elasticsearch` 包的使用，仅在实现访问 Elasticsearch 的具体实现中使用这些类。对于用户而言，这意味着一些原本使用的枚举类已被位于 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch` 中的具有相同值的枚举所替代，这些枚举在内部被映射到 Elasticsearch 的对应枚举上。

items.source: Check the sections on Deprecations and Breaking Changes for further details.
items.translation: 请查看弃用项和破坏性变更部分以获取更多信息。

items.source: methods that might have thrown a org.elasticsearch.ElasticsearchStatusException now will throw org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.RestStatusException instead.
items.translation: 之前可能抛出org.elasticsearch.ElasticsearchStatusException的方法现在将改为抛出org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.RestStatusException。

items.source: the type of the timeout property has been changed to java.time.Duration.
items.translation: `timeout` 属性的类型已更改为 `java.time.Duration`。

items.source: Spring Data Elasticsearch now uses org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.IndicesOptions instead of org.elasticsearch.action.support.IndicesOptions.
items.translation: Spring Data Elasticsearch 现已改用 org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.IndicesOptions，而不再使用 org.elasticsearch.action.support.IndicesOptions。

items.source: The classes from the package org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.completion have been moved to org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.suggest.
items.translation: 来自包org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.completion的类已移至org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.suggest。

items.source: Some properties of the org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.BulkOptions class have changed their type:
items.translation: org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.BulkOptions 类的某些属性类型已发生变更：

items.source: the type of the`refreshPolicy` property has been changed to org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.RefreshPolicy.
items.translation: `refreshPolicy` 属性的类型已更改为org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.RefreshPolicy。

items.source: This section describes breaking changes from version 4.2.x to 4.3.x and how removed features can be replaced by new introduced features.
items.translation: 本节描述了从版本 4.2.x 到 4.3.x 的破坏性变更，以及被移除的功能如何由新引入的功能替代。

items.source: Places where classes are used that cannot easily be replaced, this usage is marked as deprecated, we are working on replacements.
items.translation: 无法轻松替换的类使用位置，此类用法已标记为弃用，我们正在开发替代方案。
